title: CRISPRi-based genome-scale identification of functional long noncoding RNA loci in human cells

extraction_issues.quote: resulting in 169 “neighbor hits” and 499 “lncRNA hits,” 299 of which are distal from any protein coding gene (~90% of which would not measurably impact growth upon knockdown).
extraction_issues.type: 语义不清/疑似成分缺失
extraction_issues.reason: 该句语法上易产生歧义：499个hit中299个远离编码基因，但随后约90%“敲低不影响生长”与此处语境不符，可能原文有省略或抽取丢失成分。

extraction_issues.quote: 8 of these properties (expression, Pol2/CTCF looping by ChIA-PET, enhancers and super enhancers from (51), copy number variation) were cell type-dependent.
extraction_issues.reason: 声称8个性质但括号内仅列出4项，疑为提取遗漏或原文即如此，无法确认。

self_check: 已核对关键数值：靶向16,401个lncRNA位点、499个非邻居hit、89.4%单细胞型特异性、82.6%（表达于所有细胞系中的hit）、PVT1 tiling 1kb窗口、RNA-seq同一基因不同sgRNA相关系数0.980与不同基因0.942、LINC00263的ChIP-seq与ASO结果、机器学习预测因子及其倍数（1.66和1.4倍）。公式γ的定义（按细胞倍增归一化）与正文描述一致。不确定之处：第5页关于“299个远端hit”的句子语义不清，已在extraction_issues中标注；第9页“8 of these properties”列举不全，未擅自补全。
